system.description:
Starting at 10th level, you have learned to release your Medical chakra into controlled bursts. You gain the following abilities for which you can spend Byakugou Seals to use.

Iron Rose Spear. In place of an attack, you make when you take the Attack action, you can spend 2 Byakugou Seals. When you do, make a melee Taijutsu attack that rips and tears through the surrounding atmosphere like a sharpened spear. On a hit, you deal your [Unarmed Damage] + [Unarmed Damage] + 2d12 and the affected creature must make a Strength saving throw vs your Taijutsu (or Ninjutsu, your choice) save DC. On a failed save, they are pushed 30 feet in a direction of your choice (excluding upwards), and are Staggered.

Magnolia Hammer. In place of an attack, you make when you take the Attack action, you can spend 2 Byakugou Seals to strike the ground generating large columns of whatever materials are in the terrain you are in (Stone, Tree Trunks, Steel chunks, etc.) destabilizing the area and keeping everyone off balance. All creatures within a 15-foot radius, centering on you must make a Dexterity saving throw vs your Taijutsu (Or Ninjutsu, your choice) save DC. On a failed save you deal your [Unarmed Damage] + [Unarmed Damage] + 2d6 and the affected creatures are knocked prone and Dazed. On a successful save they take half damage.
